matches.rationale: GT1 concerns a contradiction between the textual definition of burst tolerance (difference between peak load and idle capacity) and Equation 1 (ratio of peak-available to average-required instances) in Section 3.1. Finding 1 addresses a numerical precision error in Appendix B.8 regarding fp16 vs fp32 bounds. These are completely different defects in different locations.

GT2 concerns an inconsistency between Equations 2 and 3 where the penalty factor changes from 'w' to 'β' without explanation, and the cost structure switches contexts. Finding 1 addresses floating-point precision bounds in Appendix B.8. These are unrelated defects in different sections of the paper.

pred_verdicts.rationale: This finding correctly identifies a numerical precision error (fp16 vs fp32 bounds) that is not among the ground truth defects.
